summary.text: John Wyble is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 75, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Washington Parish. First elected in 2023, John Wyble sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, House and Governmental Affairs, and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists John Wyble's occupation as chief executive officer and consultant, with a Ph.D. in leadership and research from the University of Southern Mississippi, an M.S. in vocational education from Louisiana State University, and a B.S. in agribusiness from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette.

The House page lists John Wyble's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, House and Governmental Affairs, Ways and Means, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Rural Caucus (vice chair), Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Northshore Delegation.
